name: Infiltrating the Cult

angles.text: As a priest, you may recognize that Sania Silverstream's faith is pledged to an Elemental Lord, not the Holy Light or Elune. Her pleasant religious manner conceals elemental worship.
As a rogue, you can use your talents for espionage, deception, and reconnaissance to approach the cult through its unsuspecting recruiter.

faq.answer: Sania Silverstream is a junior priestess of the Order of the Al'Aketh who lives in Shen'dar Village and presents herself as a missionary. She gently recruits locals to worship Al'Akir the Windlord.

The Order of the Al'Aketh is a cult that presents itself as a conventional religious movement. Its members revere Al'Akir the Windlord, ruler of the air elementals, and quietly recruit converts from nearby settlements to expand their influence.
faq.q: What is the Order of the Al'Aketh?

aliases: why is sania in the village
faq.answer: Shen'dar Village's leaders tolerate Sania Silverstream's missionary work to preserve a fragile peace and avoid open conflict with the cult. That truce is fraying, so they have chosen to investigate her quietly.
faq.q: Why has Shen'dar Village tolerated Sania Silverstream?

faq.answer: Al'Akir the Windlord is the Elemental Lord of the skies, storms, and air. The Order of the Al'Aketh reveres him as its sovereign and promises a place at his table to those who repent and join.

As a newcomer to Shen'dar Village, you are unfamiliar to Sania and the Al'Aketh. They are less likely to suspect you work for village leaders, so you can approach her as an interested recruit without drawing suspicion.
faq.q: Why are you asked to infiltrate the cult instead of a local?

faq.answer: Shen'dar Village's leaders suspect the Al'Aketh's recruiting hides broader, aggressive plans for the settlement. They want to uncover those plans before the fragile peace collapses.
faq.q: What are the Al'Aketh planning for Shen'dar Village?

sections.body: In Shen'dar Village, an uneasy truce with the Order of the Al'Aketh is starting to unravel. Local authorities have long tolerated Sania Silverstream, a self-proclaimed missionary living among them. The Order claims to be a peaceful religious movement and sends gentle recruiters to draw in unsuspecting followers. Village leaders let Sania recruit to keep the cult from open conflict. Now that fragile peace is wearing thin.
sections.title: A Precarious Peace

sections.body: Sania Silverstream is a junior priestess of the Order of the Al'Aketh, devoted to Al'Akir the Windlord, ruler of the air elementals. She invites newcomers to learn of her sovereign and promises them a place at his table. Shen'dar's residents know her too well to approach safely. So village leaders turn to a newcomer to earn her confidence and uncover what the cult plans for their home.
sections.title: Beneath the Missionary's Veil

summary: In Shen'dar Village, Sania Silverstream draws followers as its uneasy peace begins to fray. The village asks a newcomer to approach her and learn what the Order of the Al'Aketh intends for the settlement.
